description: Real open start times (IST) for a session type over a date range (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 14 days): `days` (all times) and `by_psychologist` (each psychologist's own times, with slug, name and role). Past times and times starting within 20 minutes are never listed. Times are not held until create_booking_draft. Use mode 'in_person' for the Kakkanad clinic. ElloMind matches clients to a psychologist: offer a specific person only when the customer asks for one (by name, or the same psychologist as before); pass psychologist to see only theirs. If this tool returns an error, never tell the customer they are fully booked.

psychologist.description: slug from by_psychologist (e.g. 'nithya-s'), only if the customer asked for that person
